english.title: Give false or misleading information to the Competition and Markets Authority
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) gave information, namely **(..DESCRIBE INFORMATION..), to the Competition and Markets Authority in connection with its functions under Part 1 of Schedule 10 of the Transport Act 2000 knowing, or being reckless as to whether, it was false or misleading in a material particular
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 14(1) and (3) of Schedule 10 to the Transport Act 2000.
